executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import hashlib,json
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_saved_high_score_leaf_contribution_v1'
parents=[
'reports/research/510300_fixed_score_price_response_timing_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_fixed_score_price_response_timing_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/result.json',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错八变量历史输入及原标签.parquet',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错十变量历史输入及原标签.parquet',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错8变量每日联合评分.csv',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错10变量每日联合评分.csv',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错8变量保存模型.json',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/纠错10变量保存模型.json',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/共同成熟训练池.json',
'reports/research/510300_daily_score_financing_input_correction_v1/固定高分不重叠机会.csv']
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for rel in parents:
    if not (ROOT/rel).is_file():raise FileNotFoundError(rel)
OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p=OUT/'protocol.json';assert not p.exists(),'协议已存在，禁止覆盖。'
obj={'study_id':'510300_SAVED_HIGH_SCORE_LEAF_CONTRIBUTION_V1','experiment_id':'E23','recorded_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'status':'REGISTERED_SAVED_MODEL_EXPLANATION_NO_REFIT',
'question':'在已经下跌的状态下，原树的正收益预期来自哪些训练成员，是否被少数月份/重叠行情支撑？',
'reason':'E22主期9机会在信号前20日均已跌1.519519%，先涨后无收益叙述不成立；需查看实际保存的正预测来源。',
'scope':'只原纠错8/10树的全部70自然高分事件，主期各9、较早各26；不增加事件或只选亏损例子。',
'membership':'使用E21已保存树的float32分支，逐当日原成熟训练池推入叶；必须复算保存节点样本数/均值和当日原预测，exit_idx<=decision_idx不变。',
'outputs':{'path':'当前输入的全部决策节点、变量、阈值、左右分支和叶','leaf_distribution':'原叶成员全部保留，均值、中位数、正负个数、最大正值及其正收益贡献占比','all_months':'按成员原信号日的日历月，保存每月全部成员数、净标签和、正标签和、负标签和；不是冲击因果归属','concentration':'单个日历月正标签和占全叶正标签和的最大份额；超过50%仅表示算术多数，不是新的交易门槛','overlap':'按每标签[entry_idx=idx+1,exit_idx=idx+6)区间列出相交连通组数；相交组不是独立经济事件或独立样本量'},
'interpretation':'分别报告主期每个实例和早期原对照，不由叶收益为正、月份集中或样本中位数直接证明未来效果/因果；所有解释来自当时已成熟标签。',
'anti_rescue':'不删大涨月份/成员，不改目标为中位数，不重加权/重拟合，不改窗口、模型、分数或持有；原高分和失败不变。',
'new_source_acquisitions':0,'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'parameter_grids':0,'source_code_edits':0,
'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'goal_achieved':False,
'parents':[{'path':r,'bytes':(ROOT/r).stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(ROOT/r)} for r in parents]}
p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'E23登记':'完成','父文件':len(parents),'固定事件':70,'新拟合':0,'新账户':0},ensure_ascii=False))
